limitations: This is a public exponentiation microbenchmark, not Falcon end-to-end qualification.
The representative 128-bit prime stresses 15-bit upper limbs; current native Falcon primes are 126-bit, so actual upper limbs are at most 13 bits and select the same 2-byte bucket.
No timing claim is made for generator/comb caching; first-use preparation remains inside the normal first call.
Root integration and cached_generator_comb_matches_fresh_preparation remain pending at archival time.
